name: wds_vtab-pets
description: wds_vtab-pets is a webdataset-packaged version of the Pets classification task (originating from Oxford-IIIT Pet) used in VTAB-style transfer/evaluation. It measures image classification performance on pet species/breed categories and is intended for evaluating transfer and representation learning methods. The dataset provides standard train/validation/test splits for benchmarking vision models.
reputation: Commonly used as a standard vision transfer/VTAB task (well-known within the transfer learning / representation learning community).
